name: zhaowen-claudemod
description: 我自用的 Claude Code mod 合集：以 marketplace 形式分发，一条 /plugin install 装走。

plugins.name: deepseek-balance
plugins.description: The DeepSeek account balance as one line above the prompt, refreshed every five minutes and by /balance.

plugins.name: moon-band
plugins.description: The moon's phase, its age and a line of poetry as one dim row above the prompt; /moon hides it.

plugins.name: novel-pane
plugins.description: A collapsible pane that reads a book in the session: /novel <path>, spaces and j/k to turn pages, the place kept per file.
